claims.statement: Determine whether a causal local retained state can replace the published O1 reference configuration, removing the common physical phase while inheriting the exact normalized native dynamics, complete fixed experiment, and actual minimizing marked connection and Fisher tensor on the original nonflat window. Supply a complete conditional construction or a precisely delimited obstruction without treating either as unrestricted closure.
claims.quantifiers: The unrestricted target asks for one regular causal local realization valid for the rich published positive C2 contextual preparation class and every admitted finite adaptive history. A sufficient construction may restrict preparation only with an explicit additional hypothesis. A negative conclusion for a specified memory class quantifies over that class only; it does not refute unrestricted causal memory.
claims.falsifier: A conditional realization fails if any admitted branch changes native time or a fixed joint kernel, recovers the erased physical angle through memory, lacks local closure, or reproduces only stored geometry. A scoped obstruction fails if an in-scope regular realization escapes its phase-field or highest-jet argument. Only a scope-matched nonexistence proof could refute the unrestricted existence target.
